title: Send values between tasks with a channel
objective: Make a channel, send a value into it from a task, and receive that value in the main program.

body.text: A channel is a pipe that carries values from one task to another. Write make, then a name, equal to a channel of text or of number. One task sends with send, and another side takes the value with receive from.

body.title: Send a message from a task
body.code:
make messages equal to a channel of text
start a task
    send "hello" to messages
say receive from messages
